sources.title: Thanjavur District: Marattas History
sources.note: Direct official district history; late-seventeenth-century foundation, Mughal/Carnatic tributary relations and European intervention. Exact Ekoji accession dates differ across official summaries, so use 1670s.

sources.title: Alagappa University: Tamil Civilization and Culture from 1336 to 1947 AD
sources.note: Direct PDF, printed pp.57-59, PDF indices 64-66: Mangammal regency, Mughal tribute, dargah grant, roads/irrigation, drought and Meenakshi. Use specific attributed facts, not textbook moral judgments about rulers or universal religious claims.

sources.title: Sarmaya: Copper-Plate Inscription, Madurai, 1733
sources.note: Direct museum description, accession 2022.26.5. Tamil grant, villages and recipient, son-in-law relationship of grantor. No unprovided inscription transcription reconstructed.

sources.title: Sarmaya: Copper-Plate Inscription, Thiruchendur, 1760
sources.note: Direct museum description, accession 2022.26.1. Monthly expenses for cotton/tobacco/trousers and Avani worship at math; deities, copper sheet and dimensions. Description does not establish every trader’s clothing or household budget.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Archaeology: Ramalinga Vilasam Site Museum, Ramanathapuram
sources.note: Indexed original department page fully exposes palace, reign 1674-1710, audience/dwelling areas, murals and colloquial captions. Longer equivalent URL times out. Query site:tnarch.gov.in/ramalinga-vilasam "dwelling" "paintings" returns this canonical node.

sources.title: Government Museum Chennai: Manual on the Numismatic Gallery
sources.note: Direct extracted PDF text; printed pp.43-44, PDF indices 52-53, Sl.No 47, stockregister 15: copper Madurai Nayak coin,18th century,2.1 g,1.2 cm, unknown provenance, Tamil Madurai on reverse in two lines. No visual palaeographic reading claimed.

sources.title: Dr Sumathi Krishnan, Music Academy: Pallaki Seva Prabandha
sources.note: Direct institutional essay, opening and discussion of Sambhamoorthy editions, story and pallaki stanza. Exact excerpt kadalimpakurōyi pallaki and six-word English excerpt; combined eight quoted lyric words. Roman transliteration, not manuscript facsimile.

sources.title: S. Subrahmanya Sastri and V. Raghavan: Sangitasaramrita, Music Academy edition, 1942
sources.note: Direct digital transcription of the 1942 primary scholarly edition, introduction sections I-II, pp.iii-vi. Host is an independent transcription, not the publisher. Raghavan’s manuscript-based catalogue identifies TulajaI/Tukkoji, Dhanvantarivilasa at son Ekoji’s request, Dhanvantarisaranidhi at Mahadevapattana and bilingual herb names. No remedy or efficacy adopted.

sources.title: Thanjavur District: Heritage, Saraswathi Mahal Library
sources.note: Direct section9: Nayak Vijayavilasam library under Raghunatha 1600-1634, Maratha support and later SerfojiII 1798-1832 collecting.

sources.note: Direct Maratha paragraphs: Ekoji foundation,1799 administrative transfer with retained fort,1855 annexation. Do not import contradictions in unrelated earlier dynastic chronology.

proposedOverrides.name: Hindu kingdoms
proposedOverrides.summary: Several southern Indian courts and communities under a broad atlas label, with different rulers and transitions.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: New contextual card for one imported regional umbrella; no shared card and no aliases.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: 1700-1715 bbox[74.7781,8.0286,79.8254,13.5274];1715-1783 bbox[77.0534,8.1168,79.8254,12.5775]. Both contain Thanjavur, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Ramanathapuram. Only 1700 contains Mysore, Padmanabhapuram andThiruvananthapuram; neither containsArcot. See decoded identity.json and point-checks.json.
batchIdentityNotes.publicCaveat: Opening explains southern location, changing western coverage and multiple states; unchanged late polygon masks 1736 Madurai transition. Narrative examples are localized, not claims of total territorial control.
batchIdentityNotes.related: Earlier hindu-kingdoms(-500 to 800), maratha, Mughal, Mysore, Vijayanagara, Carnatic, Travancore and northern Rajput records remain separate. No exact Thanjavur/Madurai/Ramnad state IDs found in inspected index.
batchIdentityNotes.evidenceLimits: Court/merchant records cannot establish representative household floor plans, universal schooling, ordinary diets, clinical efficacy or sanitation. No such details invented. Copper coin has unknown provenance and broad 18th-century date. Telugu sample is authentic transmitted work in modern scholarly Roman transcription, no invented original glyphs.
